description: Source code for a Zephyr driver for the BQ27Z746 fuel gauge, including functions for reading/writing registers, fetching properties, and device initialization.

methods.name: bq27z746_read16
methods.description: Reads a 16-bit register from the device via I2C.

methods.name: bq27z746_write16
methods.description: Writes a 16-bit value to a register via I2C.

methods.name: bq27z746_read_mac
methods.description: Reads manufacturer data (MAC) from the device.

methods.name: bq27z746_get_prop
methods.description: Retrieves various properties from the fuel gauge.

methods.name: bq27z746_get_buffer_prop
methods.description: Retrieves buffer properties like manufacturer name, device name, and chemistry.

methods.name: bq27z746_set_prop
methods.description: Sets certain properties on the fuel gauge.

methods.name: bq27z746_init
methods.description: Initializes the device, checking if the I2C bus is ready.
